kitEvidence.formula:
Yorick throws a globule of Black Mist that deals [(6 / 6.5 / 7 / 7.5 / 8 + (0.03) × AP) × (0.01)] max Health magic damage, Slows by [0.3] for [1.5] seconds and marks champions and monsters for [4] seconds. Marked enemies continuously Awaken nearby graves (but not exceeding the maximum of @Spell.YorickPassive:YorickPassiveGhoulMax@) and suffer [(0.13 / 0.16 / 0.19 / 0.22 / 0.25) × 100]% reduced Armor.

Yorick and his summoned units gain [(0.18 / 0.21 / 0.24 / 0.27 / 0.3) × 100]% Move Speed toward the mark. Mist Walkers will leap once at marked enemies that get away from them.

builds.goal: Investigate high one champion-hit Last Rites self-heal output with a finite, reproducible setup; compare controlled item swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: Q restores a level-breakpoint base plus 6/7/8/9/10% of Yorick missing HP, with reduced healing against non-champions. More own maximum HP at the same low current-health percentage can enlarge the missing-health term. This helper has no direct AP coefficient; purchased AP is not automatically heal scaling.

Yorick summons the Maiden of the Mist with [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=1050, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 7, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 100.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 11, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 200.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 16, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 250.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}]) + (0.6) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2]] Health and [50 / 75 / 100 + (0.3) × AD[statFormula=2]] Magic Attack Damage plus [2 / 3 / 4] Mist Walkers. When Yorick damages the Maiden's target, he deals [2 / 2.5 / 3]% max Health magic damage.
